items.t: Man arrested after shots fired in Charlotte County road rage incident
items.x: A white SUV was left with bullet holes and a flat tire after a Charlotte County road rage incident that ended in an arrest.

items.t: Lemon Bay High School in Englewood unveils cybersecurity classroom
items.x: Charlotte County Public Schools is opening a new cybersecurity classroom at Lemon Bay High School, offering students hands-on experience in a growing career field.

items.t: How do FL’s top gubernatorial candidates plan to lead the state?
items.x: Election day is just six days away and all the political advertising may have people thinking, what would Florida’s top gubernatorial candidates actually do in office?

items.t: ReptiDay Sarasota returns Halloween weekend with reptiles, exotic animals and educational opportunities
items.x: ReptiDay Sarasota returns Oct. 31, offering a closer look at snakes, lizards and other exotic animals while helping visitors overcome fears and learn about reptile care.

items.t: Tom Jones postpones tour dates to recover from illness
items.x: The "It's Not Unusual" singer has been on his 25-date "Come Gather Round North American Tour" since the middle of September.

items.t: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
items.x: The Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves.

items.t: Coast Guard asks public’s help locating sailor, catamaran that left Goodland
items.x: Vessel S/V ARLYN was last contacted south of the Ten Thousand Islands on Oct. 27.

items.t: Iran War's cost to American taxpayers grows to an estimated $47.1 billion
items.x: The cost of the Iran War to American taxpayers has grown to $47.1 billion, according to a new estimate the Pentagon has provided to Congress.

items.t: Sarasota Police take over city parking operations
items.x: Parking Services moves under Patrol Division; enforcement employees now called Parking Ambassadors.

items.t: UN condemns US economic embargo of Cuba though more nations sit out after Trump administration push
items.x: The U.N. General Assembly condemned the U.S. economic embargo of Cuba for the 34th year on Wednesday, even as Washington’s campaign to influence the outcome led to a number of countries voting against the resolution.

items.t: ‘She was screaming for her life’: Terrifying attempted kidnapping caught on video
items.x: A terrifying kidnapping attempt in the middle of the afternoon in Honolulu was caught on video.

items.t: Road rage incident ends in gunfire, 1 man arrested in Florida
items.x: A road rage incident in southwest Florida ended with gunfire.

items.t: Man accused of threatening girl with a gun to get in his car later determined to have .292 BAC, deputies say
items.x: The sister of a man accused of threatening a girl with a gun to get in his car said that the whole thing was a “huge misunderstanding.”

items.t: Aging Untold: Fat-free doesn’t always mean healthy

items.t: New study suggests 3 in 4 former NFL players who died from 2008 to 2023 had CTE
items.x: A new study published Wednesday estimates about 3 in 4 former NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had CTE, far higher than earlier estimates.

items.t: Riverdale HS girls basketball coach on leave pending Lee County school district investigation
items.x: Riverdale High School girls' basketball coach Ryan Magiera is on administrative leave as the School District of Lee County conducts an investigation.

items.t: Estero council reviews $20 million rail trail land purchase
items.x: The Village of Estero council discussed the purchase and sale agreement for 66.7 acres of land, valued at nearly $20 million, as part of the rail trail project ahead of Thursday's deadline.

items.t: Parents say students were forced to get off school bus and walk 3 miles home on dangerous roads
items.x: Parents in Guntown, Mississippi, say an 11-year-old girl and other children were forced to walk three miles after being told to leave a school bus.

items.t: Florida governor candidates hold separate rallies in Tallahassee one week before Election Day
items.x: Byron Donalds and David Jolly were in the city on the same day but did not appear on a debate stage.
